programs.title: Hacks 3
programs.desc: A year after satirist Deborah Vance (Jean Smart) and Ava parted ways, the former is enjoying the success of her stand-up comedy.The second one is looking for new professional opportunities in Los Angeles.

programs.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
programs.desc: A mission is underway to destroy the Ring.The team was dispersed.However, each of its members fights in the name of good.The inhabitants of Middle-earth are preparing for a battle that will decide the fate of the world.Gandalf summons the armies of Gondor and Rohan to fight.People need a ruler to unite them more than ever.The descendant of the royal house, Aragorn, must find the power within himself that will allow him to take the throne and fulfill his destiny.Meanwhile, Frodo and Sam, carrying the priceless jewel, approach Mordor.Gollum, who leads them, still hopes to regain the Ring.Using his role as a guide, he leads the hobbits to the spider's cave.At the same time, Sauron's army is approaching the fortress of Minas Tirith in Gondor.People have no chance against the enemy's numerical superiority.Aragorn decides to call for help from an army of wights.Together with the elf Legolas and the dwarf Gimli, he sets off on the Path of the Dead, from which no man has ever returned.

programs.title: Uncharted
programs.desc: New York.Young Nathan Drake (Tom Holland), a descendant of the explorer Francis Drake, works as a bartender in an upscale establishment where he does not hesitate to rob his wealthy customers from time to time.At the same time, the boy believes that he knows where the legendary Eldorado is.One day, he is visited at a bar by experienced treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan (Mark Wahlberg).The man invites the boy to participate in an expedition to find the treasure of the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, who was lost 500 years ago.Together they set off on a crazy and adventurous journey.It soon turns out that they have to hurry, because the ruthless Santiago Moncada (Antonio Banderas) and the mercenary Jo Braddock (Tati Gabrielle) are also looking for the valuables.In addition, the travelers try to find Nathan's missing brother, and because it is sometimes difficult for them to communicate, they learn to cooperate.A spectacular adaptation of a popular video game.

programs.title: Frieda's Case
programs.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programs.title: Half Man
programs.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.
